<thought>First, I need to find suitable retrosynthetic templates that correspond to the amide‑formation coupling reaction described. I will search the template catalog using the criteria provided (carboxylic acid broken, amide formed, C‑N bond formed, C‑O bond broken) and limit the results to 5 templates. Then I will apply each returned template to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
